# v1.6.0 — Node 24 Action SHAs + CI Wiring Fixes (CI-34–CI-41)

Released: 2026-05-25

## Changed
- `CI-34`: Bump all GitHub Actions SHA pins to Node 24-compatible versions across `secured_ci.yml` and `codeql.yml`.
- `CI-41`: Close Dependabot PR-25 (`starlette==0.52.1`) as not-planned. Tracked as TD-02 — starlette is a transitive dep of FastAPI; no independent upgrade path until a FastAPI major bump.

## Fixed
- `CI-35`: Replace unresolvable checkout SHA with `actions/checkout@v4.3.0` tag.
- `CI-36`: Replace hardcoded deploy-gate result strings with `needs.<job>.result` expressions.
- `CI-37`: Add `test_incident_tracker.py` to `unit-tests` pytest invocation (was silently skipped).
- `CI-38`: Declare all evaluated jobs in `deploy-gate` `needs` array; previously gate could pass with missing job results.
- `CI-39`: Bump `asyncpg` `0.30.0` → `0.31.0`; resolves `GHSA-7f4w-j353-w3mg`.
- `CI-40`: Bump `opentelemetry-sdk` + `opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc` `1.27.0` → `1.42.1`.
